market_definition: The India Alcohol Market covers the production, distribution, and sales of alcoholic beverages across India, including beer, wine, whisky, rum, vodka, brandy, and other alcoholic beverages such as gin, tequila, and fortified wine. The market assessment includes demand by product type, alcoholic strength, packaging type, price point, application type, sales segment, and state. It also covers pricing dynamics, trade analysis, consumer behaviour, drinking preferences, distribution networks, and the competitive landscape. BY PRODUCT TYPE: Beer; Wine; Whisky; Rum; Vodka; Brandy; Others (Gin, Tequila, Fortified Wine). BY ALCOHOLIC STRENGTH: Low Alcohol (below 10); Medium Alcohol (10 to 20); High Alcohol (above 20). BY PACKAGING TYPE: Bottles (less than 200 ml; 200 ml to 750 ml; 750 ml to 1.5 L; above 1.5 L); Cans (150 ml to 330 ml; 330 ml to 500 ml; above 500 ml); Casks; Other Packaging Types (5 L to 10 L; 10 L to 50 L; above 50 L). BY PRICE POINT: Premium or Luxury; Mid Range; Economy or Value. BY APPLICATION TYPE: Household Consumption; Foodservice & Hospitality; Retail (Off Trade Consumption); Duty Free & Travel Retail; Event & Catering Services; Others (Online & E-Commerce Sales, Specialty Alcoholic Beverages). BY SALES SEGMENT: Civil Distribution Channel - Off Trade (Government Liquor Stores or Corporations; Private Licensed Liquor Stores; Wine & Beer Shops; Modern Retail, where permitted; Online or Home Delivery, where permitted) and On Trade (Hotels; Restaurants; Bars & Pubs; Clubs; Other Licensed On-Premise Outlets); Defense Distribution Channel (Canteen Stores Department (CSD); Unit Run Canteens (URCs); Other Authorized Defense Institutional Channels). BY STATE: Uttar Pradesh; Maharashtra; Karnataka; Telangana; Tamil Nadu; Andhra Pradesh; Kerala; West Bengal; Haryana; Punjab; Rest of State. EXCLUSIONS: non-alcoholic beverages and general beverage products outside the defined alcoholic beverage categories; products and services unrelated to the production, distribution and sale of alcoholic beverages; standalone suppliers of raw materials, packaging materials and equipment; alcohol-related services and businesses outside the India market scope. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CHANNEL PARTNER (focus: Gin, Vodka and Whisky, for export expansion into India): an India-headquartered importer, distributor, wholesaler, stockist, licensed liquor trading company or route-to-market partner that brings in, stores and sells alcoholic beverage brands made by others to state beverage corporations, licensed retail, on-trade (hotels, restaurants, bars, clubs), duty free / travel retail or the defence CSD channel; state beverage corporations acting as the wholesale channel are included. EXCLUDED: distilleries, breweries and wineries selling only their own brands, retail liquor shops, bars and restaurants, delivery apps without a distribution licence, and raw material, packaging and equipment suppliers; media, associations and directories.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
